_readme: What the game does automatically for each card, matched by card name (case and punctuation don't matter).
The card spreadsheet holds the wording and quantities; this file holds the automation, so a new spreadsheet keeps it.
Cards not listed here are still drawn and shown to everyone; the table resolves them by hand.
Effect types and player selectors are described in backend/app/websocket/board_cards.py.
'defaults.copies' is used for cards the spreadsheet gives no quantity for.

effects.text: Promote yourself: change your job tier or title in the You panel.
Change the target of an assignment, or introduce a new one: the table updates the assignment board.
Move your pawn to another player's tile (not beyond the Black Market): click that tile on the board.
Take a Senate action from wherever you are on the board.
During War, roll an extra time and add the numbers together.
Your roll's success target is reduced by 1 (not against the Mafia).
Knives you throw and healing you use are 10 minutes more effective.
Choose any available job at any tier in the You panel.
Call a vote on the government and change it to one of your choice: the admin starts the vote.
Choose an available Tier 1 job in the You panel.
Jump forward 5 tiles and action that tile (you can pass Start), or move to the Senate if it's within 5 tiles: click the tile on the board.
Everyone reveals their time or goes to court (lose: reveal and +2 heat; keep refusing: arrested).
Every alive player takes one item of their choice: a collectable, promotion, job opportunity, hospital item or shortcut (the admin hands them out).
Charms add 1 to the roll. You can offer the drug to other players; they roll too.
No Judge in play? Discard this card. Otherwise the Judge searches players: contraband (red cards) is discarded, the Judge takes 2 hours and the player gets +1 heat.
No Judge or under Democracy: no effect. The Judge picks peasants to be paid 1 hour by government leaders and can remove up to 4 oppressions.
No Judge in play? Discard this card. The Judge picks players; each is jailed on the Judge's roll of 5+, with half the jail fee.
Every player discards two collectables.

success.text: You become the SHAG officer: choose an available job in the You panel.

effects.text: Willing players each try to roll 6 to rob the Time Bank; whoever does shares out 12 hours. If everyone fails, they all go to court.
Fill all six assignment slots. The next two assignments can target anyone with a title: double reward, and the target is demoted. Keep this card out until two are completed.

5.text: Move directly to any tile: click it on the board.

effects.text: Each charm adds 1: 7 = become Executive or +8 hours, 8 = you win the game.
Pay 4 hours now, or gamble: roll 5+ to get +2 hours; otherwise the debt doubles and goes to court.
Each Illicit job holder picks a non-Illicit victim: take 3 hours from them, or 2 collectables (their choice).
Public Service job holders may each buy two of: Job Opportunity 10 min, Hospital Item 20 min, Collectable or Shortcut 30 min (not doubled by Democracy).
Everyone who made it inside moves to the next named building tile and actions it.
Anonymous straw poll: every vote against a player costs them 1.5 hours.
The government changes at random to one of the three others: the admin sets it.
Ignore under Democracy. Each government leader faces a vote; anyone removed can't be the next leader. A Judge can decide one leader's outcome.
Launder 8 hours in 2-hour lots: to yourself roll 4+, to another player roll 3+. Failed attempts go to court for the failed amount.
Pay 1–3 hours a turn; 30 minutes interest is added at the end of each turn. Keep the card until it's paid.
Ongoing: on Collectables Promotions tiles pay tax (no job 30m, Tier 1/2 1h, Tier 3 1.5h, title 2h) until 24 hours are donated to the state.
